title: DoorDash unveils new retail partnerships to deliver clothing and footwear; Macy's is listing products directly on the DoorDash app for two-hour delivery (Sarah Nassauer/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Sarah Nassauer / Wall Street Journal: DoorDash unveils new retail partnerships to deliver clothing and footwear; Macy's is listing products directly on the DoorDash app for two-hour delivery — App joining with companies such as Anthropologie and Timberland, as well as Macy's — DoorDash is betting big that Americans want more than dinner delivered.
